end.summary:
Practised showing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi connected ten and one sticker to eleven.
Across 4 attempts, Saanvi gave 1 unaided correct response.
Saanvi counted the ten-bundle as one item when finding the total and confused the 1 in 15/17 with one.
The confusion remained at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making numbers 11–20 with one bundle of ten and loose ones. They connected ten stickers and one more with eleven, and Asha used bundles and sticks to model the numbers. Saanvi sometimes counted the bundle as one object, so the mix-up was still present at the end. At home, make one group of 10 buttons or pencils, add loose ones, and say “ten and ___ makes ___.”
